title: Expected selected width as a sum of tail probabilities
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, whose terms are conjunctions of literals on distinct coordinates. For each input $x$, select a term satisfied by $x$ if $\varphi(x)$ is true, and select the empty term otherwise; let $W(x)$ be the number of literals in the selected term. The uniform expectation of $W$ over the sign cube equals $\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\Pr[W\ge k+1]$, where the probabilities are uniform on that cube.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a disjunctive normal form on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
